class.description: DOD NOTE: DifficultyProfileRadar renders a multi-axis spider/radar polygon chart visualizing `GameplayDifficulty` across its core domains (Combat/Action, Riddle/Puzzle, Stealth/Perception, Survival/Economy, plus any entries in `custom_aspect_levels`). When a `GameplayAccessibilityOption` resource is also bound, the radar overlays a secondary `!important` effective polygon illustrating how motor/cognitive assists (such as `enemy_time_scale` or `player_damage_taken_multiplier`) temper the raw difficulty profile inside the `GameplayStyle` cascade. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
